elements.text: Captain's failure to properly monitor the aircraft's fuel state
Captain's failure to properly respond to the low fuel state
Captain's failure to properly respond to crew-member advisories regarding fuel state
Captain's inattention due to preoccupation with a landing gear malfunction
Captain's inattention due to preparations for a possible landing emergency
Failure of other flight crewmembers to fully comprehend the criticality of the fuel state
Failure of other flight crewmembers to successfully communicate their concern to the captain
Safety Board recommendations to the FAA regarding crew training and cockpit instrumentation
